notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
smtp-commands NSE retrieves full ESMTP capability list via EHLO exchange. smtp-enum-users tests for valid accounts via VRFY. Service version detection fingerprints exact Postfix/Sendmail/Exim version.

=== VRFY RELIABILITY ===
Many SMTP servers return 252 for any input including invented usernames — manual verification required. VRFY results alone are unreliable for automated enumeration.

=== CHAINING ===
smtp-commands → check for VRFY support → smtp-enum-users with username wordlist → cross-reference with SMB/LDAP usernames → test discovered usernames against IMAP with password spray.
